{{Quote|I am born of the Dark Heart, spawned in the shadows of unspeakable power by my master, Sel-Makor!|The Gormak Guardian|<ref name="Vault of the Gormak King">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Vault of the Gormak King|Voss}}</ref>}}
The '''Gormak Guardian''' was a [[vorantikus]] that had been granted [[Sentience/Legends|sentience]] by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side entity]] [[Sel-Makor]]. Sel-Makor also gave the beast the power to spread his influence and set it among the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]], intending to use it as a pawn to corrupt the Gormak. However, the Guardian was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] during a [[Mission to the King's Hall|raid]] on the [[King's Hall]] beneath [[Gorma-Koss]].
